geometry: Four fixed peers plus six antipodal pairs: pair component radii .25/.5/.75 at 12 angles, plus zero pair component. The total second moment is offset by the fixed four-peer contribution; radii are NOT total |z2|.

analysis.primary: Block-stratified conditional Monte Carlo Pearson test of input-invariant response distributions, 19999 null tables, Holm over two providers.
analysis.secondary: Per-radius direction tests (Holm over six provider/radius tests); original frozen forecast scores; same-input block transport and leave-direction-out prediction by fixed exploratory model set.
analysis.fitting: New local response models have L2=.01, scale floor .05; intercept, second-sine, second-cosine, linear second, quadratic second, signs, magnitude-only. Whole-direction holdout purges each held-out direction at all radii; baseline held separately.
analysis.intervals: Marginal action-probability Wilson 95% intervals descriptive, not simultaneous.
analysis.pilot: Offline mock stop/resume only. Previous real 256-call experiment validated parsing and model availability.
